behavior: Owner/admin session and membership are rechecked before a durable refreshPendingAt marker commits.
The provider refresh runs only after that commit; a pending marker blocks repeated refresh and internal attempt reservation/submission even when the old access token appears unexpired.
A successful provider response clears the marker in the same transaction that stores encrypted rotated tokens, after a second session/membership and connection-state check.
Provider ambiguity, local transaction failure or process death leaves the marker; fresh OAuth for the same channel clears it. No automatic retry of the old grant occurs.
